descr:
Just 2 weeks, 100,000 steps!
Walk or run 100,000 steps wherever you are!

Challenge period: 2025.10.01 ~ 2025.10.12

itps.desc:
Stage 1 (20,000 steps)
Warm-up — Arch of Triumph

• Goal: Wake up your body. Settle into your pace.
• Coaching: Don’t go out too fast! Find a comfortable, sustainable pace.
itps.desc2:
20,000 steps done. What a perfect start! Let’s keep this energy for the next stage!
Tap the link below to cheer on the Paris 20KM runners.
itps.desc3:
It's okay, the first step is always the hardest. Think of it as a warm-up—next stage is your chance to shine!
Tap the link below to cheer on the Paris 20KM runners.

itps.desc:
Stage 2 (40,000 steps)
Getting into Pace — Forest Rhythm

• Goal: Keep your pace steady. Focus on your form.
• Coaching: Now, the real work begins! Exhale longer, lock into your rhythm, and hold it steady. Don't forget to hydrate!
itps.desc2: 40,000 steps cleared. You've found your rhythm. Keep that momentum going!
itps.desc3: You came so close! You’re warmed up now, so go all in next stage!

itps.desc:
Stage 3 (60,000 steps)
Interval Rhythm — Seine River

• Goal: Vary your pace. Sharpen your focus. Keep your upper body loose.
• Coaching: Push the pace for 1-2 minutes, then recover for 1 minute. Play with your stride and arm swing.
itps.desc2:
60,000 steps! You've officially passed the halfway mark. You're doing great—keep up that pace!
Tap the link below to cheer on the Paris 20KM runners.
itps.desc3:
It's okay, you're already halfway there! Take a breath—you're more than ready for the next part of the journey.
Tap the link below to cheer on the Paris 20KM runners.

itps.desc:
Stage 4 (80,000 steps)
Overcoming the Wall — Louvre

• Goal: Reset your form. Stay motivated.
• Coaching: Steady breath, chest up, eyes forward! Don’t forget to relax your shoulders.
itps.desc2: 80,000 steps crushed! The finish line is so close. Let’s keep the last steps light and steady.
itps.desc3: Don't be discouraged! You just caught your breath before the final push. We’re almost there—let’s go together!

itps.desc:
Stage 5 (90,000 steps)
Final Sprint — Eiffel Tower Finish

• Goal: One last push to finish strong!
• Coaching: Almost there! The final sprint – keep the rhythm and power through to the finish!

You’re almost at the finish! Cheer the runners of Paris 20KM on!
itps.desc2:
So close to the finish! Ready for the final sprint?
Let’s finish this together and tap the link below to cheer on the Paris 20KM runners.
itps.desc3: Getting here is already amazing! It's not about the finish line, it's about your incredible journey. Let’s finish strong together and tap the link below to leave a cheer for the Paris 20KM runners.

title: Paris Together Challenge
